findings.summary: Removed renderer/glTF matrix forwarding wrappers and dead segment/export wiring; all consumers use the shared pinned matrix product.
Routed templated matrix-writer lowering through the existing function lowerer with shared index/type bindings.
Replaced repeated source-tree output discovery with a successful compiler-output inventory; missing/malformed records rebuild.
Recursive identity-bearing callbacks alias existing shared ownership instead of allocating per call; identity erasure retains ownership and mutable captures.
Removed manual Dawn mesh reset loops and forwarding release method; owning containers perform teardown.
Removed unread RmlUi SVG metadata; the installed package supplies the authoritative feature flag.
Removed duplicate documentation ownership tables and TODO tasks already owned by audit.md.
Deduplicated captured numeric mesh payloads independently of stage/variant metadata.
Passed the already resolved PinnedDrawConventions record through the shared mesh-block builder instead of repeating shader-key searches.
